source: due2-native: frontier_complete under a definite Pending (due2-workflows.md §6.4, decisions/0004, decisions/0026)
notes: Authored for due2; no origin result. Closes part of the gap of #30. ex:viaManager applies in every scenario and waits on ex:managerApproval, so every completion is Pending and the verdict is definite. frontier_complete is true iff every completion's frontier is the listed frontier (due2-workflows.md §6.4). An uncertain candidate makes it false when, completed T, it adds a route (scenario 1, ex:viaLegalInEU), and leaves it true when that route is dominated in every completion (scenario 2, ex:viaBothForGold); a rule that sets it false whenever a candidate is uncertain gets scenario 2 wrong (the cheaper rule that decisions/0004 compares). One unknown is within max_frontier_vars, so both scenarios enumerate it and are exact. The listed frontier is the same under decisions/0026 and under its v0.33 predecessor in every scenario, since only ex:viaManager's route suffices in both completions.

scenarios.name: the region is unknown: a completion adds a route

expected.why: ex:viaManager waits on ex:managerApproval in every completion, so the verdict is Pending. ex:viaLegalInEU is U: completed T it adds the incomparable route {ex:legalReview}, which only that completion has, so the listed frontier [[ex:managerApproval]] is not every completion's frontier and frontier_complete is false.

scenarios.name: the tier is unknown: the added route is always dominated

expected.why: ex:viaBothForGold is U, but completed T its route {ex:managerApproval, ex:legalReview} is dominated by ex:viaManager's {ex:managerApproval} (due2-workflows.md §6.3), so both completions have the frontier [[ex:managerApproval]] and frontier_complete is true.

scenarios.name: nothing is unknown: both routes are listed

expected.why: ex:viaManager and ex:viaLegalInEU apply and wait on one duty each, and the two routes are incomparable, so both are listed; ex:viaBothForGold does not apply. With no unknown there is one completion, so frontier_complete is true.
